title: A quantitative parabolic shearing criterion for disjointness of weakly mixing flows on sigma-compact metric probability spaces
author: Giovanni Forni; Adam Kanigowski
work: Multiple mixing and disjointness for time changes of bounded-type Heisenberg nilflows
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.111

contexts.role: Historical whole-PDF context was inspected; delivered exact criterion/support excerpt ranges, rather than a whole-article reproduction, are recorded in the source map.

difficulty_reason: A non-product ergodic joining is separated by a nonzero time displacement. Measurable selection and Lusin uniform continuity lift a positive-measure family of near-identity sheared pairs into the joining; uniform ergodic averages and compact control of the common time lag force contradictory invariance estimates.
